annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNESCO Global AI Ethics and Governance Observatory
key_provisions_or_claims: Zimbabwe completed UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology; country report is downloadable.
Smart Zimbabwe 2030 Master Plan is the strategic roadmap for a digital, knowledge-based economy.
Cyber and Data Protection Act provides the foundation for data governance and regulating AI development.
National ICT Policy (2022-2027) promotes inclusive opportunities.
Country indicators: 62% electricity access, 38% internet use, data infrastructure score 60.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO Global AI Ethics Observatory country profile for Zimbabwe, summarising Readiness Assessment Methodology insights. It covers the Smart Zimbabwe 2030 Master Plan, Cyber and Data Protection Act, National ICT Policy, and socio-technical indicators. It contains no robotics content.
annotation.title_en: Zimbabwe – Country Profile, Global AI Ethics and Governance Observatory
